description: This file is a minified/compiled JavaScript source for Font Awesome icon library, including utility functions, class definitions, promise implementation, and configuration setup.

classes.name: P
classes.description: Custom Promise implementation used as fallback if native Promise is unavailable.

methods.name: domready
methods.description: Executes a callback when DOM is fully loaded.

methods.name: insertCss
methods.description: Injects CSS styles into the document head.

methods.name: nextUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier string.

methods.name: classArray
methods.description: Returns an array of class names from a DOM node.

methods.name: getIconName
methods.description: Extracts icon name from class list based on prefix.

methods.name: htmlEscape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for HTML.

methods.name: joinAttributes
methods.description: Joins object attributes into a string for HTML.

methods.name: joinStyles
methods.description: Joins style object into a CSS string.

methods.name: transformIsMeaningful
methods.description: Checks if a transform object has meaningful transformations.

methods.name: transformForSvg
methods.description: Generates SVG transform strings based on transform object.

methods.name: transformForCss
methods.description: Generates CSS transform string from transform object.

methods.name: fillBlack
methods.description: Sets fill attribute to black in an SVG abstract element.

methods.name: deGroup
methods.description: Flattens SVG group elements.

methods.name: makeIconMasking
methods.description: Creates SVG mask elements for icons.

methods.name: makeIconStandard
methods.description: Creates standard SVG icon elements.

methods.name: asIcon
methods.description: Wraps SVG content as an icon element.

methods.name: asSymbol
methods.description: Creates SVG symbol element for icon sprite.

methods.name: makeInlineSvgAbstract
methods.description: Builds inline SVG icon structure with optional mask and transformations.

methods.name: makeLayersTextAbstract
methods.description: Creates layered text icon structure.

methods.name: makeLayersCounterAbstract
methods.description: Creates layered counter icon structure.

methods.name: defineIcons
methods.description: Defines icon set with given prefix and icon data.
